Create project's folder based on pre-defined folder structure

Source: R/createProject.R
createProject.Rd

A generic function to create a project's folder based on pre-defined folder structure.

Usage

createProject(dir, structure = c("OUCRU_RCT_wInterim"))

Arguments

dir

a character specifies where to create the project's folder. It must not exist yet, or be an empty folder.

structure

a character specifies the pre-defined folder structure to be used.

Value

The path of the created project folder, invisibly. A message confirms where the project was created.

Examples

proj <- file.path(tempdir(), "myStudy")
createProject(proj)
#> Project myStudy was created in /tmp/RtmpYywTFt
list.files(proj)
#> [1] "Analysis"        "Data"            "Documents"       "InterimAnalysis"
#> [5] "myStudy.Rproj"  
unlink(proj, recursive = TRUE)
